transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I'm here because I've been feeling extremely down and depressed for the past seven months. I've completely lost all my motivation and interest in the things I used to enjoy. It just feels like a constant struggle to do anything, and I really need some help.
Have you ever experienced periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, high, or hyperactive, perhaps needing very little sleep?

Yes, I actually did. For about two months, I had this intense surge of energy and felt unusually happy and elevated. I was constantly hyperactive and on the move, which felt like the complete opposite of how down I am now.
During either your high or low periods, did you ever experience things like hearing voices, seeing things others couldn't, or holding very strong beliefs that others told you weren't true?

No, I've never experienced anything like that. I haven't heard or seen things that weren't there, and I've never held any unusual or strange beliefs. It has really just been my mood and energy levels that have been shifting so drastically.
During that two-month period of high energy, did it cause any severe problems in your daily life or work, or did you ever need to be hospitalized because of it?

I was never hospitalized, but it definitely caused some serious problems. During that time, I went on reckless shopping sprees and made some really foolish business investments that ended up putting me in a lot of financial trouble.
Did these financial troubles or your behavior during that time lead to other major consequences, such as losing your job, legal trouble, or your relationships falling apart?

No, I didn't lose my job, face any legal trouble, or have my relationships completely fall apart. However, the reckless spending and investments did cause severe financial distress for both myself and my family.
During that high-energy period, did you feel like you were still able to function and be productive, or was your thinking so disorganized that you couldn't get anything done?

I actually felt incredibly productive and did far more work than usual, often starting multiple activities at once. Even though my thoughts were spinning incredibly fast and felt crowded and hard to control, it didn't stop me from constantly being on the move and getting things done.
How did your family or friends react to your behavior during those two months? Did they express deep concern or try to get you to seek help?

Honestly, I can't quite remember their exact reactions or if they tried to get me to seek help. I was so caught up in my own high energy that I wasn't really paying attention to what they thought at the time.

No, it wasn't impossible to manage things at all. In fact, I felt like I was doing far more work than usual and constantly starting new projects. I was extremely hyperactive and felt highly productive, even though I was making some reckless decisions at the same time.
During that high-energy period, did you feel a decreased need for sleep, such as feeling fully rested and energized after only three or four hours of sleep?
I don't really recall having a decreased need for sleep during that time. To be honest, I'm not sure what my sleep patterns were like because my mind was so focused on staying busy.
